why: Islands are connected components of a grid graph, as in Number of Islands, but now each flood fill also counts the cells it visits. The answer is the largest such count.
hints: This is Number of Islands with one extra number per island. Which number?
Flood-fill each unvisited land cell with DFS or BFS over the four direction offsets and count the cells the fill touches.
Visited grid plus a stack; for each start cell count pops, then update the best. O(rows * cols).
pitfalls: Diagonal neighbours do not join islands; use only the four orthogonal directions.
